confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on crowd-sourced and third-party estimates that disagree (Numbeo, traveltables, a French price site, Tripbase), with Bled-specific and Ljubljana/Nova Gorica data mixed together. Beer, cocktail and wine are less certain, and wine and cocktail use local price relationships and bar-versus-shop gaps where direct data was weak. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and Bled's seasonal tourism context; no accommodation search or live listing was inspected. Euro-to-USD conversion used an approximate EUR/USD of about 1.10, derived from the FX observation and a secondary AUD/EUR quote. The FX figure was reported by a secondary source as the RBA 4:00 pm rate and was not verified on rba.gov.au, so treat it as provisional.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors are based on Bled-specific aggregated estimates, cross-checked against Ljubljana and Nova Gorica data and national Slovenian cost-of-living figures. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates for a mid-sized Alpine lake resort in the Slovenian Alps with high summer demand, benchmarked against comparable European lakeside resort towns.
